comparison.objective: Lift and balance a long board for 10 seconds while a roller moves on it; candidate breaks and collects four insert tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Continuous bimanual tilt correction under moving load versus one arm stabilizing a mandrel while the other delivers regulated impacts, followed by fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Ten seconds lifted with no drop, roller fall, or robot contact versus four contact-loaded fractures and physical containment without damage.
comparison.reason: Dynamic balancing tests continuous pose regulation, whereas the candidate tests precision impact fracture and recovery.
